usage: deskops atoms add-namespace [-h] [--root ROOT] --meaning MEANING
                                   --use-when USE_WHEN
                                   --do-not-use-when DO_NOT_USE_WHEN
                                   [--example EXAMPLE [EXAMPLE ...]]
                                   namespace

positional arguments:
  namespace             Namespace name, such as pattern.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --meaning MEANING     What this namespace means.
  --use-when USE_WHEN   When to use this namespace.
  --do-not-use-when DO_NOT_USE_WHEN
                        When an existing namespace should be preferred
                        instead.
  --example EXAMPLE [EXAMPLE ...]
                        Example tag using the namespace; repeat or space-
                        separate as needed.
